 "rationale": "Neither diff-pair polarity has headroom at 0.6 V CM with 1.62 V and Vth 0.8/1.15 V. Fix: compare at 0.25 V (scaled vref and feedback) and lift both inputs with matched NMOS diode shifters; their injected currents cancel. The pass gate is a current-mirror (low-Z) node, so loop Gm scales with load. The 1 uF output cap is dominant; UGF is 5-190 kHz and the X/G poles are above 1 MHz. Iq is about 35 uA."}

PARAMS = {
    "w_pass": (4000.0, 2500.0, 5000.0),   # pass PMOS total width [um]
    "l_pass": (0.5, 0.3, 0.8),            # pass / gate-diode L
    "w_pair": (16.0, 8.0, 40.0),          # OTA NMOS pair W (L = l_amp)
    "w_load": (16.0, 8.0, 40.0),          # OTA PMOS mirror load W
    "w_m3":   (4.0, 2.0, 12.0),           # 2nd-stage PMOS CS W (same L as load)
    "l_amp":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),            # L of pair / load / M3
    "w_tail": (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),           # tail W (L=1) -> Itail = 10uA*w_tail/10
    "k_n":    (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),           # Mn4/Mn3 mirror ratio
    "v_cmp":  (0.25, 0.2, 0.3),           # comparison level (scaled ref / fb)
    "r_div":  (96e3, 48e3, 200e3),        # total output divider resistance
    "cout":   (1e-6, 3e-7, 1e-6),         # internal output capacitor
}

def _vgs_for(lt, dev, W, L, I, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
    for _ in range(36):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if abs(lt.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"]) < I:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref, vout_t = spec["vref"], spec["vout_target"]
    imax, imin, cl = spec["iload_max"], spec["iload_min"], spec["cl"]
    N = 200.0                                   # pass : gate-diode ratio
    wp, lp = p["w_pass"], p["l_pass"]
    la = p["l_amp"]
    k = max(2, int(round(p["k_n"])))
    vc = p["v_cmp"]
    beta = vc / vout_t
    C = p["cout"]

    # ---- dividers: fb = beta*Vout + Ib*(R1||R2), r = vc + Ib*(Ra||Rb) -> shifter currents cancel
    Rt = p["r_div"]
    R2 = Rt * beta
    R1 = Rt - R2
    Rpar = R1 * R2 / Rt
    a = vc / vref
    Rtr = Rpar / (a * (1 - a))
    Rb = a * Rtr
    Ra = Rtr - Rb

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF=10uA into ibias diode
    n.M("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 10.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_tail"], 1.0)      # OTA tail
    n.M("Mbp", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)              # 2 uA
    n.M("Mp0", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", 4.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Mpsf", "gf", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", 2.0, 1.0)                # 1 uA shifter bias
    n.M("Mpsr", "gr", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    # matched diode level shifters (sources at fb / r, both ~vc)
    n.M("Msf", "gf", "gf", "fb", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Msr", "gr", "gr", "r", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    # 5T OTA: fb side on diode -> X rises when vout rises
    n.M("Mpa", "d1", "gf", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_pair"], la)
    n.M("Mpb", "x", "gr", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_pair"], la)
    n.M("Ml1", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", p["w_load"], la)
    n.M("Ml2", "x", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", p["w_load"], la)
    # stage 2: PMOS CS -> NMOS mirror (1:k) -> gate diode Md -> pass (1:N)
    n.M("M3", "n3", "x", "vin", "vin", "pfet", p["w_m3"], la)
    n.M("Mn3", "n3", "n3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5)
    n.M("Mn4", "g", "n3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0 * k, 0.5)
    n.M("Md", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", wp / N, lp)
    n.M("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", wp, lp)
    # feedback / reference dividers, output cap
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.R("Ra", "vref", "r", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "r", "vss", Rb)
    n.C("Cout", "vout", "vss", C)

    # ---------------- first-order predictions (tt, 27C) ----------------
    itail = 10e-6 * p["w_tail"] / 10.0
    ip = itail / 2
    try:
        vgp = _vgs_for(lut, "n", p["w_pair"], la, ip, 0.4, vc)
        opp = lut.op("n", p["w_pair"], la, vgp, 0.4, vc)
        vgl = _vgs_for(lut, "p", p["w_load"], la, ip, 0.6)
        opl = lut.op("p", p["w_load"], la, vgl, 0.6)
        A1 = opp["gm"] / (opp["gds"] + opl["gds"])
        ipl = imin + vout_t / Rt
        iph = imax * 1.2 + vout_t / Rt                    # mirror Vsd-mismatch allowance
        I3l, I3h = ipl / (N * k), iph / (N * k)
        I3b = ip * p["w_m3"] / p["w_load"]
        v3l = _vgs_for(lut, "p", p["w_m3"], la, I3l, 0.8)
        v3h = _vgs_for(lut, "p", p["w_m3"], la, I3h, 0.8)
        v3b = _vgs_for(lut, "p", p["w_m3"], la, I3b, 0.8)
        gm3l = lut.op("p", p["w_m3"], la, v3l, 0.8)["gm"]
        gm3h = lut.op("p", p["w_m3"], la, v3h, 0.8)["gm"]
        Gml = beta * A1 * gm3l * k * N
        Gmh = beta * A1 * gm3h * k * N
        vsl = _vgs_for(lut, "p", wp, lp, ipl, 0.6)
        vsh = _vgs_for(lut, "p", wp, lp, iph, 0.6)
        gdsl = lut.op("p", wp, lp, vsl, 0.6)["gds"]
        gdsh = lut.op("p", wp, lp, vsh, 0.6)["gds"]
        w = 2 * PI * 1e3
        ps = min(abs(complex(Gml, w * C)) / gdsl, abs(complex(Gmh, w * C)) / gdsh)
        psrr = 20 * math.log10(ps)
        load_reg = abs(v3l - v3h) / (A1 * beta) / (imax - imin)
        verr = max(abs(v3l - v3b), abs(v3h - v3b)) / (A1 * beta) / vout_t * 100
        line_reg = 1e3 * max(gdsl / Gml, gdsh / Gmh) + 1.0
        under = 1e3 * ((imax - imin) / Gmh + (imax - imin) * 0.3e-6 / (C + cl))
    except Exception:
        psrr, load_reg, verr, line_reg, under = 50.0, 3.0, 0.8, 3.0, 15.0
    iq = (10e-6 + itail + 2e-6 + 2e-6 + vout_t / Rt + (imin / N) * (1 + 1.0 / k)) * 1e6

    return n, {"vout_err_pct": verr, "load_reg": load_reg, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "psrr_1k": psrr, "iq": iq, "undershoot": under,
               "ripple_settled": 0.5}
